story: During Stage 2 of the Tour of Magnificent Qinghai 2026, a strong pace was set on the first climb, leading to an attack by Cristian Rodríguez. Five riders including Caicedo joined the breakaway, which collaborated effectively. However, under the controlled pace set by Burgos and Cofidis, the break was caught with 40 km remaining. Immediately after, Fernandez launched a solo attack, maintaining his lead until he was caught in the final kilometre. Bessega ultimately won the group sprint ahead of Manenti.
